weeks.focus: Post-holiday rebuild; swim & bike only (tibia still healing).
Wedding week — light & fresh. Fri–Sat off; easy ride Sun.
Run returns (walk-run stage 1, alternate days). Aerobic swim/bike base, VO2 touch on the bike.
Walk-run stage 2.
Walk-run stage 3. Biggest base-1 week.
Recovery + tests (CSS Wed, FTP ramp Sat). Hold walk-run stage 3.
Walk-run stage 4, then continuous running next week.
First continuous runs (25–30'). Long ride 2h45.
Continuous running established (4 runs incl. first brick). Run volume now capped at +10%/wk.
Recovery week (~70%).
Christmas week — Fri is optional/easy. Threshold work begins on the bike.
Strides added. Long ride 3h15.
Biggest base week.

Recovery + tests. CHECKPOINT: tibia symptom-free on all runs since wk 8? If yes → London stays on & run intensity unlocks from wk 16. If not → see a sports doctor; drop London to the Olympic/T100 plan only.
Build begins: threshold bike, IM-power blocks on long rides, open water from wk 17.
First run quality (cruise intervals) — only if wk 14 checkpoint passed.
Open-water swims start Sundays. Get the wetsuit before this week.
Recovery + CSS retest.
Optional: a local sprint tri on Sun 21 Feb for transition practice (swap for Sun long run).
Long ride 5h.
Peak build week before T100.
Recovery + FTP retest. Set T100 race targets from new FTP.
Gold Coast T100 (2km/80km/18km) Sun 21 Mar — controlled IM-rehearsal effort, not all-out (London in 5 weeks).
Post-race recovery; rebuild by Saturday.
Big block: London long run + IM long ride.
Peak pre-London week: 6h ride + 27.5km long run (Z2).
London mini-taper (run −30%); last long ride before the 19-day bike gap.
London Marathon Sun 25 Apr at Z2. Fly Wed 21 Apr (last ride Tue).
Post-marathon recovery in London. No running Mon–Fri; no road bike.
Rebuild in London: swim, run, gym — gym bike / Wattbike if available (by HR).
Back on the bike — IM-specific block. Heat acclimation starts (Thu).
Biggest IM-specific week: 5h15 ride (3.5h @ IM power) + 45' brick; 3.8km continuous swim.
Last big weekend (2 weeks out), then taper begins.
Taper (~60%): keep intensity, cut volume. Last strength session Mon.
Race week — travel to Cairns, sleep, carb-load Fri–Sat (8–10 g/kg ≈ 640–800 g/day).
